_meta.name: native-connector-precedence-map
_meta.purpose: Maps workspace-mcp tool verbs to their native Anthropic-connector equivalents. Used by native-connector-precedence-check.sh PreToolUse hook to block workspace-mcp calls when a native equivalent exists.
_meta.prefix_scheme: Name-based as of claude CLI 2.1.228: mcp__claude_ai_<Name>__<verb>, where <Name> is the connector display name with spaces replaced by underscores. Verified against a live headless roster probe 2026-08-20. Signal: .intent/signals/SIG-CONNECTOR-PREFIX-SCHEME-CHANGE-2026-08-19.md (Workspaces repo).

legacy_native_prefixes_hex._note: LEGACY, retired by 2026-08-19. Older builds addressed the same connectors by hex-UUID prefix; zero occurrences remain in ~/.claude.json. Kept only so old transcripts and docs stay recognizable. Never emit these as guidance.

_meta.precedence_is_not_prohibition: Blocking is a speed bump, not a wall. workspace-mcp is load-on-demand for cases the native connector does not cover. A blocked call can proceed by writing a reasoned, single-use, TTL-bounded grant to ~/.claude/native-connector-fallback-grant.json (the hook prints the exact command). Reviewed 2026-07-31 after the env-var bypass was found unreachable from MCP tool calls.

mcp__google-workspace__search_gmail_mess.note: Use native search_threads. Returns same thread metadata. Native is pre-authenticated via Anthropic OAuth.

mcp__google-workspace__get_gmail_message.note: Use native get_thread. Returns full message content.

mcp__google-workspace__draft_gmail_messa.note: Native create_draft handles single-draft creation. For batched drafts, fallback is allowed.

mcp__google-workspace__manage_gmail_labe.note: Native has separate verbs per action. Pick the right one based on intent.

mcp__google-workspace__modify_gmail_mess.note: Native has thread-level and message-level label ops.

mcp__google-workspace__send_gmail_messag.note: Native Gmail gained send_message, reply, and forward (live roster 2026-08-20); the old no-native-send claim is retired. Sending routes state to another human, so the cross-human L0 rule applies regardless of which tool carries the send. Attachment support on native send is unverified; send-with-attachment is a legitimate grant case.

mcp__google-workspace__get_events.note: Native uses list_events with calendar_id filter.

mcp__google-workspace__manage_event.note: Native has separate verbs per action.

mcp__google-workspace__search_drive_file.note: Native search_files supports Drive query syntax.

mcp__google-workspace__list_drive_items.note: Native list_recent_files is recency-ordered. For folder-listing use search_files with folder filter.

mcp__google-workspace__get_drive_file_do.note: Native returns content directly rather than URL. Adjust caller accordingly.

mcp__google-workspace__create_drive_file.note: NOT identical. Native create_file requires the content inlined in the tool call (text_content or base64_content). It has no fileUrl and no local-path upload, so bulk or large-file uploads from disk cost the full file size in tokens. workspace-mcp create_drive_file accepts fileUrl. For a handful of small files use native; for bulk or large local files, either take a fallback grant or call the Drive REST API directly with the stored credential.

mcp__google-workspace__check_drive_file_.note: Native returns full permission list including public-access state.

mcp__google-workspace__update_drive_file.note: Native update_file observed in live roster 2026-08-20; parameter semantics not yet exercised. If it cannot do the specific update, take a grant.

mcp__google-workspace__manage_drive_acce.note: Native share_file observed in live roster 2026-08-20; whether it covers this exact permission op is unverified. Try native first; take a grant if it cannot.

mcp__google-workspace__set_drive_file_pe.note: Native share_file observed in live roster 2026-08-20; whether it covers this exact permission op is unverified. Try native first; take a grant if it cannot.

mcp__google-workspace__get_drive_shareab.note: Native share_file observed in live roster 2026-08-20; whether it returns a shareable link is unverified. Try native first; take a grant if it cannot.

mcp__google-workspace__search_docs.note: Native search_files with file_type='document' achieves same result.

mcp__google-workspace__create_spreadshee.note: Native create_file makes a Google Sheet directly: pass text/csv content and it auto-converts to a spreadsheet (verified 2026-07-08), or create an empty one via mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet. Always on brientate@gmail.com. Fall back to workspace-mcp modify_sheet_values / format_sheet_range only for cell-level writes and formatting on the already-created file.

mcp__google-workspace__create_doc.note: Native create_file makes a Google Doc directly: pass text/html or text/plain content and it auto-converts, or create empty via mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.document. Fall back to workspace-mcp batch_update_doc / modify_doc_text only for in-place structured editing.

mcp__google-workspace__create_drive_fold.note: Native create_file with mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.folder creates a folder. Equivalent, no content involved. Prefer native.

fallback_allowed._note: These workspace-mcp verbs have NO native equivalent. They are legitimate fallback uses. Hook allows them without warning. Re-checked against the live name-based roster 2026-08-20; verbs the roster contradicted (send_gmail_message, update_drive_file, manage_drive_access, set_drive_file_permissions, get_drive_shareable_link) moved up to blocked_with_native_equivalent.
